searchText: <@278762485497069569> someone should submit a PR to remove miner control of the gas limit. There are multiple people who seem to want it and unrelated to 1559 it may be valuable. <@105284782065209344> Tip is multiplied by gas used. Thoughts <@!273808422753796097> ? hmm this is a legitimate point Although, I feel like especially at current high-gasprice conditions, the amount miners gain by pushing the gaslimit up from tips is less than the amount miners would gain in the status-quo regime by fiddling with the gaslimit to find the (gaslimit * gasprice) maximizing point 1 gwei * 20 million gas is only 0.02 ETH, 1% of the block reward Fair enough, revenue could be so small miners don't bother, though that's also an argument for why miners may not care about txs at all if it's trivial revenue. Either they care about fee revenue and try to maximize it or they don't care and might even ignore txs to reduce chance of being uncled. 2718 (Typed Transactions) got moved to EFI. I'll be adding tests to it this weekend to prep it for inclusion in clients. How would people here feel about a PR that converts 1559 to depend on 2718? I can do the legwork, I just don't want to put in the effort if it will get rejected for some reason.
